name: zwj-sequence-split-at-the-joiner
description: a zero-width joiner arrives in a different delta from the character before it. It is invisible and has no width, which is what makes it the character a cleanup pass is most likely to drop
kill: trim or filter zero-width characters from a delta before appending it in the TEXT_MESSAGE_CONTENT case of the default apply; the joiner is then lost from the assembled value
